description: This file defines the ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber class, which subscribes to kernel events in a Symfony-based PHP application to enforce authorization checks on controllers based on user permissions and request context.

classes.name: ScreenAuthorizationSubscriber
classes.description: An event subscriber that manages authorization logic during controller dispatch and exception events in a Symfony application.

methods.name: onControllerEvent
methods.description: Checks user permissions and access rights when a controller is triggered, throwing exceptions if access is denied.

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles ForbiddenException by redirecting to a custom forbidden page.

methods.name: getControllerInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the controller object from the ControllerEvent.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Registers event handlers for kernel controller and exception events.
